messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to match the action in the motion reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to match the reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands in an open plaza, turning its body and head while raising and moving its arms in a slow, gesturing motion.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium-long shot keeps the figure centered in the frame.","clothing":"A dark, form-fitting long-sleeve top and matching pants with a thin light stripe down the side, plus dark shoes.","hair_color":"White or very light gray.","hairstyle":"Short, swept-back hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered humanoid figure with a slim build, shown mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza with a glossy reflective floor, a domed glass building with glowing neon rings on the left, and a large concrete building with rows of lit windows on the right."},"uncertain":["The figure's face is not clearly visible, so facial features and exact gender are unclear.","The figure's hands and any held object are partly obscured by motion and angle."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's arm-raising and head-turning gesture with a slower, more restrained motion: the figure turns slightly, lowers its arms, and makes small arm/hand movements near the torso, ending in a standing pose. The futuristic plaza, character model, clothing, hair, and static camera remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to match the motion reference, while preserving identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera.
uncertain: The reference motion is subtle and partly obscured in the output, so exact pose-by-pose alignment with the reference cannot be confirmed.
